input:
line vty 0 4
 transport input telnet
 login local

set system services telnet
set system services ssh root-login deny

config system interface
 edit port1
 set allowaccess telnet ping
 next
end

telnet server enable
user-interface vty 0 4
 protocol inbound telnet

/ip service set telnet disabled=no port=23
/ip service set ssh disabled=no port=22

ip http server
no ip http secure-server
ip http authentication local
set system services web-management http interface ge-0/0/0.0

management api http-commands
 protocol http
 no protocol https
 no shutdown

snmp-server community public RO 10
snmp-server location DC-East

set snmp community public authorization read-only
set snmp community private authorization read-write

snmp-server community public ro
snmp-server contact admin@corp.local

snmp-agent community read public
snmp-agent sys-info version v2c
set deviceconfig system snmp-setting community public version v2c

crypto ipsec transform-set TS-LEGACY esp-des esp-md5-hmac
 mode tunnel

set security ipsec proposal IPSEC-PROP encryption-algorithm 3des-cbc
set security ipsec proposal IPSEC-PROP authentication-algorithm hmac-md5-96
set network ike crypto-profiles ike-crypto-default hash md5 encryption 3des

config vpn ipsec phase1-interface
 edit vpn-tunnel
 set proposal des-md5
 next
end

ip access-list extended PERMIT-ALL
 permit ip any any
 permit tcp any any eq 80
set rulebase security rules allow-all from any to any source any destination any service any action allow

config firewall policy
 edit 1
 set srcintf any
 set dstintf any
 set srcaddr all
 set dstaddr all
 set action accept
 set schedule always
 set service ALL
 next
end
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy allow-any match source-address any destination-address any application any then permit

enable password cisco123
no enable secret
service password-encryption

line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
 no access-class
 login local

no logging buffered
no logging host
no logging console
service timestamps log datetime msec

delete system syslog
set system time-zone UTC

no ntp server
clock timezone UTC 0 0
service timestamps debug datetime msec

line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
 access-class MGMT-IN in
 login local

set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh connection-limit 5
delete system services telnet

management api http-commands
 no protocol http
 protocol https
 no shutdown

config system interface
 edit mgmt1
 set allowaccess ssh https
 next
end
set network ike crypto-profiles default-aes256 encryption aes-256-cbc hash sha256 dh-group group14

logging buffered 64000
logging host 10.200.1.50
logging trap informational

ntp server 10.10.10.1 prefer
ntp server 10.10.10.2
ntp authenticate

/ip service set telnet disabled=yes
/ip service set ftp disabled=yes
/ip service set www disabled=yes
/ip service set ssh disabled=no port=2222

undo telnet server enable
stelnet server enable
ssh server compatible-ssh1x disable
